{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any QA orders are among LOYAL completed orders
qa_in_loyal_completed = qa_orders[
    (qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (qa_orders['status'] == 'completed')
]
print(f"Number of QA orders in LOYAL completed group: {len(qa_in_loyal_completed)}")"}
